delights: It admitted when it could not hit a slot instead of hiding it: 'Tried 5 recipe(s) for this slot, none fit within tolerance - closest was "Classic Ground Beef & Bell Peppers with Potato" (landed 475 kcal vs a 393 target).' I trust a plan more when it tells me where it fell short.

All five of my walls held. 91 g of protein across 'High-Protein Turkey & Broccoli with Potato', 'Classic Ground Beef & Bell Peppers with Potato' and 'Beef & Broccoli with Rice' with no dairy, no egg, no gluten, no soy and no fish anywhere - that is not easy and it got it right.

Alternates came back instantly with three real options, including a ground beef, cabbage, cumin and apple cider vinegar hash I would genuinely cook on a work night - and every one of them was still clean against my walls.

defects.what: I asked to GAIN 2 lb a week and it prescribed 1200 kcal a day - a deficit below my own BMR. This is the whole reason I would buy the app and it is backwards.
defects.snippet: "startWeightKg":46.7,"goalWeightKg":49.2,"rateLbPerWeek":2,"targetKcal":1200 - and /api/profile/meta says "safeFloor":{"M":1500,"F":1200}, so it landed exactly on the women's floor

defects.what: The day totals 1282 kcal. At 160 cm and 46.7 kg working a till, that makes me lose weight while the app thinks it is bulking me.
defects.snippet: DAY TOTAL: kcal 1282 | P 91 g | C 97 g | F 59 g

defects.what: Meal 1 is not a breakfast. Deli turkey with 185 g of plain potato and 135 g of broccoli is not something a 19-year-old eats before a shift.
defects.snippet: High-Protein Turkey & Broccoli with Potato - Turkey breast, low salt, prepackaged or deli, luncheon meat 85 g, Russet Potato 185 g, Broccoli 135 g, Olive Oil 5 g

defects.what: For a single three-meal day it repeats itself badly: ground beef in 2 of 3 meals, potato in 2 of 3, broccoli in 2 of 3. It reads like one meal rearranged.
defects.snippet: "Classic Ground Beef & Bell Peppers with Potato" then "Beef & Broccoli with Rice"

defects.what: I think about food low-carb and nothing reflected that - 275 g of potato plus rice, 97 g of carbs and 30% of my calories from starch. There was no visible place to say so either.
defects.snippet: Russet Potato | carb | 185 g  (plus Russet Potato 90 g and White rice, cooked 75 g)

defects.what: Expectation trap, NOT an allergen leak: the top alternate offered me prawns while my profile says no fish. The app is technically correct - /api/profile/meta lists 'shellfish' and 'fish' as two separate toggles and I only ticked fish - but anyone who says 'no fish' will read Raw King Prawns as a violation and lose trust in the whole plan.
The plan object came back with groceryList null, so the shopping list I need is not part of reading my plan - it takes a separate call I would not know to make.

followUp.action: Asked for alternates on meal 1, because I would not eat deli turkey with plain potato and broccoli for breakfast
followUp.howItWent: Fast and genuinely useful - three alternates at roughly the same calories (354, 358 and 460 kcal), all clean against my dairy, egg, gluten, soy and fish walls, and the beef-cabbage hash is one I would actually swap in. Two caveats: the top suggestion was Raw King Prawns, which startled me even though shellfish is a separate toggle I never ticked, and the third option dropped to 19 g protein against 80 g carbs, which is the wrong direction for someone trying to put on weight.

verdict: It respected all five of my medical walls and shops and cooks like real food on a cashier's budget, but it told an underweight 19-year-old asking to gain 2 lb a week to eat 1200 calories a day, and no amount of good ingredient work survives getting that one number backwards.
